HD Video Systems

Complete digital FPV kits for OEM platforms: transmitter, camera and antennas in one package.

A complete digital FPV system in one part number: HD video transmitter, low-light camera and circularly polarized antennas, matched and tested together. The AeroLink GT8 Kit offers 22 ms average latency, 8 channels and 1080p onboard recording, so OEMs can integrate a proven video link instead of sourcing parts separately.
